comment: Delta Sharing freshness: one row per day (Apr-2024 .. Sep-2026) and shared table received from the JP (Tokyo head office), EMEA and AMER lakehouses - provider region, share, refresh status, last refresh time, provider version, lag in hours vs the 24-hour SLA, stale flag (lag > 24h), consecutive stale days, row count and schema drift. Storyline 13: share_jp_parent_rating was not refreshed 11-15 Aug 2026 (5 stale days, lag up to 125h). Lag and row counts are point-in-time per day: average / max them, never sum. Grain: one row per day per shared table.
